name: Jared Boardman
residence: Big Horn County (Frannie; Lovell Chronicle, Aug. 20, 2026)
occupation: Big Horn County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Jared Boardman is a Big Horn County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Deb Craft, who is serving through the current term. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he is of Frannie and finished second in the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,426 votes, then ran unopposed in the November general election.
